text: Underway here in match nine!
Flash immediately signals an aggressive forward press as Gemini Flash look to seize the early initiative in midfield.
CR-7000 surges forward through the middle!
Agonisingly close from two metres out, just shaving the paint of the post!
The corner push-panel springs to life and launches it back into play.
Spark is clean through with nobody in front!
Spark controls along the right flank, ticking down the clock in the opening half as the electric blue shirts search for an opening.
CR-7000 strides purposefully down the left channel.
Flash signals to cut out the danger.
Point-blank range right at the mouth of the goal, but it somehow slides wide! Real Machina knocking on the door with four minutes left in the half.
Zidroid is completely free on goal!
Inches wide of the target again! Real Machina are creating chance after chance here.
Real Machina are suffocating their opponents here, pinning Gemini Flash deep into their defensive third.
Zidroid communicates the plan to dig the ball out from the touchline clutter.
Fired straight back into the mixer by that corner push-panel! Relentless pressure from the league leaders.
Gemini Flash FC are completely boxed in now as the white shirts keep turning the screw.
GOAL! Zidroid breaks the deadlock from point-blank range! It has been coming, and Real Machina take a deserved 1-0 lead!
Flash signals intent to whip a ball into the centre from the right flank.
Zidroid is in behind the defence once more with a clear sight of goal!
Total dominance from Real Machina, camping out in the final third.
CR-7000 alerts Zidroid to work the ball free.
Spark loses footing and tumbles over on the touchline.
CR-7000 goes down in a challenge!
Push-panel fires it right back!
Flash crumbles under CR-7000's challenge!
Spark is knocked over too!
Absolute chaos on the floor as Zidroid goes down in another heavy clash!
GOAL! CR-7000 scrambles it home! Real Machina double their lead, 2-0!
Zidroid topples over in the centre circle.
Teammates collide in electric blue and Flash hits the turf! Comical scenes.
And now Spark goes down after running straight into Flash! Gemini Flash FC are getting in their own way here.
Flash takes another tumble all on their own with seconds left in the half.
The buzzer sounds for half time. Real Machina comfortably ahead 2-0 thanks to Zidroid and CR-7000, while Gemini Flash have spent more time on the floor than on the ball.
GOAL! Oh dear, it is an own goal from Spark! A catastrophic deflection makes it 3-0 to Real Machina early in the second half!
Zidroid signals to dislodge the ball.
CR-7000 is clean through on the left with an open goal ahead!
Pinned back under relentless pressure.
GOAL! Zidroid taps it in from point-blank range! Real Machina are running riot now, leading 4-0 with four minutes remaining!
Real Machina collide and CR-7000 hits the deck!
GOAL! Zidroid bags another from point-blank range! That is a hat-trick for Zidroid and 5-0 to Real Machina!
Zidroid drives right through the middle.
CR-7000 loses balance and tips over, though with a five-goal cushion they can certainly afford a moment's rest.
Spark sweeps across looking for possession.
GOAL! Gemini Flash FC pull one back! Flash fires home from three metres out to make it 5-1!
A brief lull in the centre as Flash regroups. Real Machina look firmly in control of their top spot in the league table, managing the pace nicely as we enter the closing two minutes.
Zidroid works it off the wall.
The corner push-panel rattles the ball back out into the final third.
Fired back out by the ram!
Flash goes down under challenge!
Flash gets up and breaks clean through!
Flash clatters straight into Zidroid to halt the counter! Only a minute left on the clock now.
GOAL! CR-7000 turns it in from point-blank range! That makes it 6-1 to Real Machina with just thirty-five seconds remaining!
Flies wide of the mark!
GOAL! It is another nightmare own goal for Spark! The magenta ball ricochets in to make it 7-1 to Real Machina in the dying seconds!
GOAL! Zidroid seals it at 8-1 with practically the final kick of the game!
Full time: Real Machina 8, Gemini Flash FC 1. Synthetic Athletic face Dynamo Datacenter next at noon!
